7 recommended clinics for CoolSculpting in Nagoya! Explanation of plan fees, fat dissolving injections, differences from Hyf, etc.

 

「I want to receive CoolSculpting in Nagoya, but I don't know which clinic will provide the appropriate treatment.」

"I want to make a decision after understanding the market price and the risk of side effects."

Many people may have the same problems as mentioned above.

CoolSculpting is a fat cooling treatment that uses medical equipment approved by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare and the US FDA.

Its unique feature is that it allows you to aim for partial thinning without using a scalpel, using a mechanism that freezes and naturally excretes subcutaneous fat.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.

How CoolSculpting reduces fat

The reasons why CoolSculpting is supported are as follows:medicalThere are two pillars: a proven mechanism of action and acceptance by domestic and international regulatory bodies.

It is by properly understanding the mechanism of the treatment that you can realistically grasp both the expectations for its effectiveness and its limitations.

Mechanism of fat freezing and three points for acceptance and adaptation
  • Mechanism of natural elimination of fat cells through apoptosis
  • Positioned as a medical device approved by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare and FDA
  • Effective for subcutaneous fat, but not for visceral fat

Let's check three points in order: the mechanism by which fat cells are gradually eliminated by cooling, the acceptance of medical devices, and the conditions of the applicable area.

CoolSculpting is a treatment that uses medical equipment approved by both the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare and the FDA.

Having this knowledge before undergoing treatment is the first step in clarifying the criteria for choosing a clinic.

Apoptosis mechanism that cools fat cells and naturally excretes them

CoolSculpting reduces fat cells by approximately-11 degreesThis is a procedure that reduces fat by cooling the body from front to back and causing the cells themselves to die naturally.

This “natural death”apoptosisAn important feature of this phenomenon is that the cells do not die, but instead disappear in line with the body's normal program.

Fat cells damaged by cooling will be removed after the treatment.1-3 monthsIt is then excreted from the body through the lymphatic system.

The surrounding skin, nerves, and muscles are more resistant to low temperatures than fat cells, so theyOnly fat cells are selectively affectedIt's structured.

By repeating multiple cycles, you can aim for further changes by reducing fat cells in the target area with just one treatment.20〜25%This is because it has been reported that approaches to decrease.

Flow of fat excretion through apoptosis
  • Cooling temperature: Cools fat cells to around -11 degrees
  • Effect: Fat cells disappear due to apoptosis (natural death of cells)
  • Drainage period: Excretes from the body through the lymphatic system over 1 to 3 months after treatment
  • Selectivity: Skin, nerves, and muscles are not affected; only affects fat cells
  • Reduction rate: Reduce fat cells in the target area by approximately 20-25% with one treatment

The excreted fat cells will not regenerate, but the remaining fat cells will enlarge, so continuing to manage your diet after the procedure will help maintain your results.

Be sure to understand that it will take several weeks to several months to see results before planning your treatment.

Positioned as a medical device approved by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare and FDA

CoolSculpting equipment is AmericanFDAwas approved as a fat cooling treatment device in 2010, and in JapanMinistry of Health, Labor and WelfareIt is also accepted as a medical device.

This approval is granted after a review body reviews clinical data regarding effectiveness and consideration of treatment risks.Fundamentally different from unauthorized equipmentIt's the positioning.

The fact that a product is approved as a medical device means that there are standards regarding manufacturing, management, and usage conditions, and clinics that use genuine products are obligated to follow those standards.

On the other hand, fat cooling menus provided at beauty salons do not use medical equipment and there is no guarantee that the practitioner is a doctor, so they cannot be compared on the same level.

Even if you are directed to a treatment that calls itself CoolSculpting outside of a medical clinic, be sure to check the equipment used and the qualifications of the practitioner. The starting point for risk avoidance is determining whether the device is a legitimate medical device.

When choosing a clinic in Nagoya, check the clinic's website and initial consultation to see if they have official CoolSculpting equipment.

Subcutaneous fat can be expected to improve, but visceral fat is excluded.

How cool sculpting workssubcutaneous fatonly, and accumulates deep in the abdomenvisceral fatis not subject to treatment.

Subcutaneous fat is the fat that can be pinched and lifted, and is located at a depth that can be suctioned and cooled with the applicator, allowing the device to reach the action.

Since visceral fat exists around the organs in the abdominal cavity, it cannot be physically reached by cooling from the body surface and cannot be reduced with this treatment.

Difference between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat
  • subcutaneous fat: Fat that can be pinched and lifted. Located at a depth that can be suctioned and cooled with an applicator, it is targeted for cool sculpting.
  • visceral fat: Present around organs in the abdominal cavity. Not applicable for treatment as cooling does not reach the body surface
  • Guide to distinguishing between: If you can feel the thickness of your abdomen by pinching it with your hands, it is likely that the fat is mainly subcutaneous fat.

If you are concerned about visceral fat,Improving lifestyle habits with a focus on dietary management and aerobic exerciseis required, and the purpose is different from CoolSculpting.

Even if you are concerned about your stomach area, whether CoolSculpting is effective or not depends on whether the fat is subcutaneous fat or visceral fat.

If you can feel the thickness of your abdomen when you pinch it with your hands, it is likely that the fat is mainly subcutaneous fat, so please check with your doctor if the procedure is suitable for you.

At clinics in the Nagoya area, the unit price per cycle etc. varies depending on the clinic, soThe criterion for judgment is to compare the total amount.It will be.

  • Simulation of cost per cycle and total amount when performing treatment on multiple areas
  • How to reduce costs with monitor plans and campaigns

It is characterized by a wide range of target areas, from wide areas such as the abdomen and thighs to detailed areas such as the chin.

Please check in advance whether the areas you are concerned about are within the scope of CoolSculpting, and then perform a price simulation.

List of applicable areas such as abdomen, waist, upper arms, thighs, chin, etc.

Areas that can be treated with CoolSculpting are:applicator(Suction cup) It is divided into small parts depending on the shape.

The main areas targeted are the abdomen, waist, back fat (around the bra), thighs (inner and outer), upper arms, above the knees, under the chin, and flanks.

  • Fat-dissolving injections are suitable for small areas; CoolSculpting is suitable for large areas of fat.
